svg.title: A loudspeaker on the left faces to the right into air, drawn as many small dots. The dots are in vertical bands that are alternately bunched close together and spread out, repeating along the page. Two bunched bands are labelled particles close together and two spread-out bands are labelled particles spread out. A double-headed arrow pointing left and right is labelled particles vibrate backwards and forwards. A separate arrow pointing right is labelled direction the sound travels. The vibration arrow and the direction arrow are parallel.
